content.comment_body: Hello, thank you to anyone who can assist. In my [product_name] software application, I need to configure over 80 parameters. I’ve read that the VM only allows 64 parameters. Is this accurate? Is there any solution to work around this limitation? If not, I would suggest increasing the VM size in future generations of [product_name].
You are correct. The VM mapping table allows only 64 entries. However, you can also use the 32 analog network inputs as an additional resource.

There are many signals available in standard VM mode, so you don’t need to duplicate them. Digital inputs, analog inputs, digital outputs, analog outputs, markers, and timers are included across the entire Ethernet signal. Refer to the help section in [product_name] software and search for Parameter VM mapping; it contains detailed information on available signals.

analysis.insight_summary: Users face a strict limitation in [product_name] software, where the VM mapping table supports only 64 parameter entries, impacting advanced applications. Suggestions include using additional analog network inputs, but the main restriction remains a challenge and is a source of user frustration. There is a call for expanding VM capabilities in future software versions to accommodate complex needs.
analysis.user_expectations: Users want to map more than 64 variables in the VM and are looking for either a workaround or confirmation that future software releases will remove or increase this limitation.
